task.question: How many bird flight paths were monitored in the Aberdeen Bay study?
task.evidence: 10 March – A study by Vattenfall and Spoor using AI-assisted video monitoring of 2,007 bird flight paths near an offshore turbine at Aberdeen Bay over 19 months reports no confirmed collisions, with observed avoidance behaviour suggesting lower-than-expected impacts of wind turbines on seabirds
